title: Mere Hussain Ko Hindustan Pyaara Hai
body:
Mere Hussain ko Hindustan piyara Hai
Yahi sabab Hai har ek laabpa Inka charcha Hai
Mere Hussain ko Hindustan piyara Hai :2
1) gheeratha laakho Mai jab fatema
Ka noore Nazar
Ye khehraha Tha binne Saad se Ali ka pisar
Tu bhejde mujh Bharat mere irada Hai
Mere Hussain ko Hindustan
piyara Hai (2)
2) yahan nahi Hai koi qaaid mazhabo
Millat
Hussain waaloon ki karta Hai
Har koi izzat
Har ek shehre Mai gham Karbala ka hota Hai
Mere Hussain ko Hindustan
Piyara Hai (2)
3) yahan sajate Hai Hindu bhi Ghar mohharam Mai
Sabeele aab lagate Hai shaha ke gham Mai
Hussain waloon ko Pani pilaya jaata Hai
Mere Hussain ko Hindustan
piyara Hai (2)
4) har ek quam otha to Hai bawafa ka
Alam gulabe ittr see dhoti Hai zuljana ke qadaam
Aqidatho ka har ek Dil Mai deep jalta Hai
Mere Hussain ko Hindustan
piyara Hai (2)
5) dare Hussain pa aate Hai mannate lekhar
Pallat ke jaate Hai is Daar see izzate lekhar
Jhukane waala yaahan sar baland hota Hai
Mere Hussain ko Hindustan
piyara Hai (2)
6) manake dehkelo zahid aaza ke farsh pa soog
Ye khehke aate Hai ghazi har ek dharm ke loog
Azaa ka farsh Hai ahinsa ki patashala Hai
Mere Hussain ko Hindustan piyara hai (2)
